reason: Mirai is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Scopely (itself acquired by PIF-owned Savvy Games Group for $4.9B in 2023) and describes itself in its own live Workable posting as 'a video game support studio based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia' whose leadership reports into Scopely's global engineering org — it fails Ben Cole's niche on four independent counts: not an independent studio (subsidiary of a mega-cap parent, an explicit drop rule), not US-based (Riyadh, on-site), not PC/console (Scopely is mobile-first, and Mirai is a support/service arm rather than a studio entering full production on its own funded title), and not lacking technical-operations ownership (it is directly hiring FTE Site Reliability Engineer - Observability, Senior AI Engineer, and a Director of AI reporting to the CEO, i.e. it is building the ops layer in-house with sovereign-fund capital rather than needing a fractional owner for it); the matched jobs in the pack (QA Lead, Junior FP&A Analyst, Arabic Community Manager for MENA) are generic growth hiring, not confessions of the unowned-ops pain Ben fixes.

company.name: Mirai, a Scopely company (Mirai Arabian International Company Limited)
